# All Alcohol and Chem Plan Checklist

The easiest locations to obtain these plans are listed below. Many of these plans can also be acquired through player vendors, events, and daily quests.

To access and purchase plans from MODUS, you must have started the base Enclave questline and gained access to the Whitespring Bunker.

To add the quests "Tipsy Taste-Test" and "Wasted on" to your daily quest rotation, you need to have completed the quest "__Wasted on Nukashine__."

Mr. Squeeze is part of __Random Object Encounters__.

__Project Paradise__ is a Public Event.
